rounds: Recruiter screen with light technical questions

rounds: Rounds: 2 technical (DSA), 1 system design, 1 hiring manager (one 2021 report adds an HR round)
Some teams run a stack-specific round (e.g. JS/CSS/React or Java + DevOps)
